theorem_steps.claim: Let v_hat be any nonzero dimensionless boundary velocity receiver from the strict model.
A physical velocity has dimension U_length/U_time, so v_phys = v_hat*(U_length/U_time).
For any target c>0, choosing U_length/U_time=c/v_hat gives v_phys=c.
Therefore numerical agreement with c is not a source theorem unless U_length and U_time are independently strict-sourced and a Lorentz/light embedding is exported.
